note: Foot splash knots (Kris, 2026-11-25): the pedal pressed down quickly and let up, so the hats close briefly and open, the foot up (open) at the end. From Kris SPEAR captures SplashV1-V3 of the same hats. Per knot: the band envelope (frames x the plugin 22 one-third-octave bands, 10 ms frames, the square root of the summed SPEAR partial amplitude squared, from the first frame with a partial), and each mode weight within its band (the 683 modes of HiHat_A60.json; the square root of the SPEAR energy within 0.4 % of the mode in the first 300 ms, floored at 8 % of the band strongest, unit norm per band), as hihat_envelopes.json and hihat_weights.json. velocity: matched by attack level (first 20 ms) to the closed EDGE knots, as the open knots were. openness 1.0: the capture ends with the foot up.
